_what: The controls the shared ui parts draw that a show rule can hide (subject `control`, show/show-rules show-of.ts controlShown). Every hover or preview card is `cards.hover.<surface>`: its caller names its surface's path, and `cards` says which control each of the ui part's own card kinds is (a card whose caller names none is `default`).

controls.label: Preview cards in lists (visual-database lists, galleries, boards, card layouts)
Preview cards in every other panel
controls.drawn_at: show/hover-preview/HoverPreview.tsx, show/surface-preview/SurfacePreviewCard.tsx when the caller names no surface (dashboard tiles, next-step pictures, clips, project tree)
